dedupe_keys.name: industrial info resources iir global market intelligence databases chemical processing petrochemicals and industrial manufacturing plants and projects

description: Commercial databases of industrial plants, production units and capital projects worldwide. The IIR pages say its Global Market Intelligence (GMI) platform for chemical processing tracks chemical projects, plants and production units from petrochemicals to specialty chemicals, plastics and rubbers, including green hydrogen and ammonia, following the life cycle of assets, projects and contracts, with coverage of chlor-alkali, industrial gases, plastics and rubbers, agricultural chemicals and specialty chemicals; a parallel industrial manufacturing database tracks capital and maintenance activity in automotive, semiconductors, data centres and core manufacturing, and an energy service covers petrochemical projects. Access is by paid subscription, with an MCP connector for AI assistants limited to the datasets in a subscription; the licence is IIR's subscription terms, and formats and plant counts are not stated on the pages read. Coverage is global. Caveats: built for sales and market intelligence, so field definitions and verification methods are not public. For simulation it can supply plant and unit lists with project status and timing for industrial exposure and future capacity scenarios when open inventories fall short. A related catalogue record is the Global Chemicals Inventory from Global Energy Monitor.
